svg.title: FinTrust architecture
svg.text: FinTrust Transaction Insights and Risk Monitoring System: architecture
VPC: two private subnets in two Availability Zones. No internet gateway, no NAT Gateway.
Used by every part of the system
may reach RDS on port 5432 and
by IAM token: no password exists.
and alert Lambdas at every step,
every route needs the API key
